_comment: Claude Code MCP config for remote MCP Gateway on Google Cloud Run.
Copy the relevant section into your .claude/settings.json or .mcp.json.
MOBILE: Use the 'url' transport — no local process needed.
DESKTOP: Can use either 'url' (remote) or 'command' (local) transport.
Replace MCP_GATEWAY_URL with your Cloud Run service URL.
Get it with: gcloud run services describe mcp-gateway --region=europe-north1 --format='value(status.url)'

dws-gateway._comment: Remote MCP Gateway on Cloud Run (for mobile + desktop)

dws-gateway-local._comment: Local MCP Gateway (for desktop development — no Cloud Run needed)
